name: Corineaus
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Corineaus is a hero of British legend. He fought and defeated the giant named Gog or Gogmagog. Little else is recorded of him. His chief deed is the slaying of the monster.

okr.objective: Corineaus is a British hero who slew a giant.
key_results: He defeated the giant called Gog or Gogmagog.
He was an ancient British warrior.
Little else is known of him.
